children: PACS Group, Inc. (NYSE: PACS) (“PACS” or the “Company”), announced today that it will present at the 2026 Jefferies Healthcare Services and Technology Conference on September 15, 2026, in Nashville, TN.

Jason Murray, Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of the Board; Carey Hendrickson, Chief Financial Officer; and Josh Jergensen, Chief Operating Officer, will present on the Company's operations, growth strategy, and related information.
The presentation will be webcast live at the following link from 10:20 to 10:50 a.m. CT:
. The webcast will be archived approximately an hour after the event and will be available at this link for 90 days.

PACS Group, Inc. is a holding company investing in post-acute healthcare facilities, professionals, and ancillary services. Founded in 2013, PACS Group is one of the largest post-acute platforms in the United States. Its independent subsidiaries operate 355 post-acute care facilities across 21 states serving over 33,400 patients daily. References herein to the consolidated “Company,” as well as the use of the terms “we,” “us,” “our,” “its” and similar verbiage, refer to PACS Group, Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries, taken as a whole. PACS Group, Inc. and its subsidiaries that are not licensed healthcare providers do not provide healthcare services to patients, residents or any other person, and do not direct or control the provision of services provided or the operations of those provider subsidiaries. All healthcare services are provided solely by its applicable subsidiaries that are licensed healthcare providers, under the direction and control of licensed healthcare professionals in accordance with applicable law. More information about PACS is available at https://IR.pacs.com. The information on our website is not part of this press release.
